name: 4-MTA
summary: Empathogen with very low chronic toxicity but high risk of acute harm due to mixed serotonin release and MAOI action. There are some reports that indicate it does not have a notable euphoric effect.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: 4-MTA is a monoamine releasing agent (MRA). It was originally characterized as a selective serotonin releasing agent (SRA). However, the drug was subsequently found to more weakly induce the release of dopamine as well. 4-MTA shows a similar balance of monoamine reuptake inhibition as MDMA.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin releasing agent; Monoamine oxidase inhibitor

uses.text: 4-Methylthioamphetamine (4-MTA), also known as para-methylthioamphetamine (MTA), is a serotonergic designer drug of the amphetamine family developed in the 1990s by a team led by David E. Nichols, an American pharmacologist and medical chemist, at Purdue University.

sideEffects.en: It releases serotonin and also blocks the enzyme that breaks serotonin down, so it can cause serotonin syndrome and dangerous overheating. Its effects come on slowly, which has led people to take more, and it was linked to several deaths in Europe in the late 1990s.
sideEffects.zh: 它會釋放血清素，同時抑制分解血清素的酵素，因此可能引起血清素症候群與危險的體溫過高。它的作用出現得很慢，曾使人以為無效而追加用量；1990年代後期，它在歐洲與數起死亡事件有關。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会释放血清素，同时抑制分解血清素的酵素，因此可能引起血清素症候群与危险的体温过高。它的作用出现得很慢，曾使人以为无效而追加用量；1990年代后期，它在欧洲与数起死亡事件有关。

fact.en: David Nichols's team developed it in the 1990s as a research tool that releases serotonin. On the street it became known as flatliners.
fact.zh: David Nichols的團隊在1990年代開發了它，作為能釋放血清素的研究工具。在街頭上，它被稱為「flatliners」。
fact.zhHans: David Nichols的团队在1990年代开发了它，作为能释放血清素的研究工具。在街头上，它被称为「flatliners」。
